# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| LLMClient | utils/llm_client | Unified interface to multiple LLM providers |
| PlaybookManager | playbook/manager | Core playbook CRUD, delta updates, persistence |
| WorkerAgent | agents/worker_agent | Generates RED/GREEN/REFACTOR code via LLM prompts |
| IncrementalPlanner | agents/incremental_planner | LLM-driven next test increment planner |
| IterativeTDDRunner | agents/iterative_tdd_runner | Orchestrates the full RED→GREEN→REFACTOR iteration loop |
| TDDCycleRunner | agents/tdd_cycle_runner | Runs one TDD cycle with GREEN retries and learning |
| PythonLanguagePod | agents/python_language_pod | Python pod: delegates code gen to WorkerAgent, execution to PodmanOrchestrator |
| PodmanOrchestrator | agents/podman_orchestrator | Stateless sidecar execution with security hash verification |
| PodmanRunner | agents/podman_runner | Rootless Podman container lifecycle and pulse |
| Reflector | core/reflector/module | Analyzes task outcomes and extracts learning insights |
| Curator | core/curator/module | Synthesizes insights into playbook delta bullets |
| Generator | core/generator/module | Executes tasks with playbook context and bullet retrieval |
| BulletRetriever | playbook/retrieval | Hybrid (semantic + keyword) bullet retrieval |
| ImportFilter | agents/import_filter | Detects forbidden imports and builtins in generated code |
| ContextMapBuilder | utils/context_map | Builds AST context map for code relevancy |
| ExperimentLogger | storage/experiment_logger | Unified experiment logging (PostgreSQL/SQLite) |
| PlaybookRepository | storage/repository | PostgreSQL + pgvector repository for playbooks |
| BulletDeduplicator | playbook/deduplication | Semantic deduplication of bullets |
| TokenEfficiencyReporter | analytics/token_efficiency | Cross-language token efficiency scoring |
| PerformanceAggregator | broker/performance_aggregator | Aggregates agent performance from audit trail |
| AdaptiveBroker | broker/adaptive_broker | Routes tasks to best agent based on learned metrics |
| RegressionDetector | broker/regression_detector | Detects quality regressions across model versions |
| LanguagePod | agents/language_pod | Protocol for language-specific TDD execution pods |
| ProjectArchitect | contracts/project_architect | Decomposes project spec into module dependency DAG |
| ModuleArchitect | contracts/module_architect | Generates module-level contracts with shared state |
| ModuleTDDBuilder | contracts/module_tdd_builder | TDD-based module implementation builder |
| AuditStore | audit/store | Append-only hash-chained audit event store |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Main as main
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Agent as WorkerAgent
    participant Orchestrator as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Container as PodmanRunner
    participant Reflector as Reflector
    participant Curator as Curator
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager
    participant Audit as AuditStore

    Main->>Runner: run_from_feature(feature_path)
    activate Runner

    loop For each cycle until planner says COMPLETE
        Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle)
        activate Planner
        Planner-->>Runner: PodSpec (test_file, impl_file, gherkin_context)
        deactivate Planner

        Runner->>Cycle: run(spec)
        activate Cycle

        Cycle->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Agent: generate_test(spec)
        activate Agent
        Agent->>Agent: _test_prompt(spec)
        Agent->>Agent: llm_client.generate(prompt)
        Agent-->>Pod: test code string
        deactivate Agent
        Pod->>Pod: ImportFilter.check(code)
        alt Forbidden import or security breach
            Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult(error="ForbiddenImport/SecurityBreach")
            Note right of Cycle: RED aborted, no retry
        else Normal RED
            Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test_file: code, impl_file: existing})
            activate Orchestrator
            Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
            activate Container
            Container-->>Orchestrator: PulseResult (stdout, stderr, passed)
            deactivate Container
            Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
            deactivate Orchestrator
            Pod->>Pod: commit_to_disk(code, test_file) if not security failure
            Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult (red output)
        end
        deactivate Pod

        alt RED aborted or never pulsed
            Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult(success=False)
            Note right of Runner: Cycle ends, RED failure logged
        else RED passed (test fails as expected)
            Cycle->>Audit: emit(TEST_GENERATED)
            loop GREEN retries up to max_attempts
                Cycle->>Pod: run_green(spec with error_feedback)
                activate Pod
                Pod->>Agent: generate_implementation(spec)
                activate Agent
                Agent->>Agent: _impl_prompt(spec)
                Agent->>Agent: llm_client.generate(prompt)
                Agent-->>Pod: implementation code
                deactivate Agent
                Pod->>Pod: ImportFilter.check(impl_code)
                alt Forbidden import or security breach
                    Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult(error="ForbiddenImport/SecurityBreach")
                    Note right of Cycle: GREEN aborted, break retry loop
                else
                    Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test_file, impl_file})
                    Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
                    Container-->>Orchestrator: PulseResult
                    Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                    Pod->>Pod: commit_to_disk(impl_code) if passed
                    Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult (passed or failed)
                end
                deactivate Pod
                alt GREEN passed or aborted
                    Cycle-->>Cycle: break retry loop
                else Failed
                    Cycle->>Cycle: collect error_feedback for next attempt
                end
            end

            alt GREEN did not pass
                Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult(success=False, green_attempts)
            else GREEN passed
                Cycle->>Audit: emit(IMPLEMENTATION_GENERATED)
                Cycle->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
                activate Pod
                Pod->>Agent: generate_refactor(spec)
                Agent-->>Pod: refactored code
                Pod->>Pod: ImportFilter.check(refactored_code)
                alt Forbidden import
                    Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult(error="ForbiddenImport")
                else
                    Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test_file, impl_file: refactored})
                    Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
                    Container-->>Orchestrator: PulseResult
                    Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                    Pod->>Pod: commit_to_disk(refactored) if passed
                    Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult
                end
                deactivate Pod
                Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult(success=refactor_passed)
            end

            opt Learning loop (reflector + curator)
                Cycle->>Reflector: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
                activate Reflector
                Reflector-->>Cycle: ReflectorOutput
                deactivate Reflector
                Cycle->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
                activate Curator
                Curator->>Playbook: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
                Curator-->>Cycle: CuratorOutput
                deactivate Curator
                Cycle->>Audit: emit(PATTERN_LEARNED) for each bullet
                Cycle-->>Runner: cycle_result with learned_bullets
            end
        end
        deactivate Cycle

        Runner->>Audit: emit(CYCLE_COMPLETED)
    end

    Runner-->>Main: IterativeResult (complete, success, cycles)
    deactivate Runner
```
